title: AAB and ABB Patterns
short: Find what comes next when one part repeats twice.

blocks.html: Some patterns have two of one thing: clap, clap, stomp. Clap, clap, stomp. The part that repeats is three long.

blocks.name: pk-pic
blocks.cap: Star, star, moon … what comes next?

blocks.html: Find the part that repeats. Then keep it going.

For the grown-up: Do AAB patterns with sounds and movement: jump, jump, sit. Use snacks: cracker, cracker, raisin. Saying the pattern out loud helps a lot. Keep screen time short: two or three problems, then play.

items: Try it at home: Jump, jump, sit, jump, jump, sit.
